content:
Privacy Policy

This privacy policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website and services.

How We Collect and Use Your Information

We collect personal information that you provide when you place an order, submit information at checkout, contact us through a form, or otherwise communicate with us. This may include your name, phone number, email address, billing and shipping address, and order details.

We use this information to process and deliver orders, provide customer support, send order-related communications, help prevent fraud, and operate and improve our website.

We may share information that is necessary to fulfill orders and operate the website with service providers, including payment processors, shipping and delivery providers, hosting and website providers, and other providers required to fulfill orders.

We use reasonable security measures to help protect personal information. We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, including fulfilling orders, providing support, meeting legal or accounting requirements, and resolving disputes.

To ask about your personal information or this policy, contact us using the details below.

Information Sharing and Security

We may share personal information with service providers that assist with operating our website and fulfilling orders, as described above. We use reasonable security measures to help protect personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

Your Rights

You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time. You may also opt out of receiving marketing communications from us.

Cookies

We use cookies to enhance your experience on our website. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings, though this may affect the functionality of the site.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us.
